dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire It's a little bit of a red flag, but can be made up for with the right attitude.

@dogecoin_empire I had given up on all of that. When I met her I knew I wanted her to be the one, on some level, but didn't give it too much conscious thought. I just enjoyed the time that I did have, and treated her well. I stayed aloof, but she never left. We've been married for 12 years.
